title: "When Evil Lurks" and the expectations of intelligence

commenti.body:
Yeah, I found the main character to be very realistic. By the end, you know his flaws and you know he won’t overcome them.

I’d hoped that the pandemic would kill these sorts of criticisms, but no such luck!

I understand the theme of actions having consequences but this movie really felt like scene after scene of people being absolutely dumb as hell.  Credit for not holding back on the violence but it really just felt comical to me. Maybe it was supposed to be? Maybe not? I don't know. Maybe something didn't translate to English and it's a better movie in its native language. I just know I was very disappointed in the writing and acting for a movie that has been as praised as it is. I may revisit it though because people really seem to love it.

Your mention of 2020 I think is key. It really felt like a movie that was made in reaction to the COVID-19 pandemic. All the characters know what to do in the case of a demonic possession, but some deny the reality right in front of their face, or think the rules don't apply to them, and it just cascades from there. I don't know if Demian Rugna was thinking about that when he wrote it but it was all I could think about while watching it.
